attempts.summary: Created an SSH CA on node1, signed the host's ed25519 key into a certificate, configured sshd to present it via HostCertificate, diagnosed and fixed an SELinux mislabeling issue that initially blocked sshd from loading the cert, and verified end-to-end that a client trusting only the CA key (no pinned host key) connects successfully. Performed the mandatory single-node restart, confirming the boot identity changed and all state (sshd, certificate config, CA-trust connectivity) recovered afterward.
